_comment: Provider template — FILENAME=ROUTE (aliyun-bailian -> qwen-bailian: the credential+endpoint channel; token var derives from it). `_family` = MODEL LINEAGE (qwen) — the same/different-family judgment unit (model-routing.md). `model` = the pinned per-generation id, never part of the filename. Route: Alibaba Bailian PAY-AS-YOU-GO DashScope. RENAMED aliyun-bailian -> qwen-bailian (family-first: the platform name is ambiguous — DashScope hosts qwen/glm/deepseek/kimi; the file pins the qwen lineage; the pi port names the same route qwen-bailian). EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via `_token_env`); no code change. See model-routing.md. ADR #40.
